items.title: Windows Remote Desktop Leaves Behind Image Fragments Attackers Can Stitch Into Screenshots
items.description: Whenever someone uses Windows Remote Desktop, the operating system quietly saves visual fragments of the active session. As recently highlighted by SCYTHE Labs, attackers can easily extract these breadcrumbs and rebuild them into readable screenshots.
